desc: Special short commemorating the 10th anniversary of the Bananya series. When I woke up, I was in an unfamiliar world. In front of me was a cat peeking out of a banana, a "Bananya." I couldn't believe my eyes. For some reason, my body was also made of a banana... (Source: TMS Anime Official YouTube C
